title: Authorizer list: No authorizer, the customer's contacts, then the payer's
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with two contacts, contact A1 and contact A2, that can be picked as Authorizer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with two contacts, contact B1 and contact B2, that can be picked as Authorizer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Authorizer field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The list starts with "No authorizer".
  • Contact A1 and contact A2 come next.
  • Contact B1 and contact B2 come last.
  • Each contact shows its customer's name on a second line: customer A's name under contacts A1 and A2, customer B's name under contacts B1 and B2.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12306 (Story 4, Authorizer list when someone else pays)

  • S4-R1: “The Authorizer list shows "No authorizer", then the customer's authorizer contacts, then the Bill To's.”
  • S4-R2: “Each contact shows its customer's name on a second line.”
  • Key Decisions: “The authorizer list adds the Bill To's contacts when the Bill To differs.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
